name: Commerce Referral
description: Refer-a-friend rewards for Drupal Commerce, built on Commerce promotions and coupons: each user gets a single-use referral coupon to share; when a friend redeems it and the order is placed (or paid), the referrer is automatically awarded a single-use kickback coupon. Reward value comes from admin-configured promotions; supports multiple referral types, condition-gated code generation, self-use prevention, and admin reporting.
project_description:
Commerce Referral
 Provides a referral system for Drupal Commerce that allows customers to refer friends and receive rewards.

 Features 
 
 Referral Code Generation : Automatically generates unique referral codes for users 
 Kickback Rewards : Awards reward coupons to referrers when their referrals complete orders 
 Flexible Configuration : Configure when kickbacks are awarded (on order placement or payment) 
 Conditional Access : Control who can generate referral codes using configurable conditions 
 Multiple Referral Types : Support for different referral types with different promotions 
 Self-use Prevention : Prevents users from using their own referral codes 
 Admin Reporting : View referral statistics and track successful referrals 
 
 How It Works 
 
 User generates referral code : When a user visits their referral page, a unique coupon code is automatically created 
 Referral code is shared : The user shares their referral code with friends 
 Friend uses code : The friend applies the referral code at checkout to receive a discount 
 Kickback is awarded : When the order is placed/paid (depending on configuration), a kickback coupon is automatically created for the referrer 
 Referrer redeems reward : The referrer can use their kickback code on their next order
